name: pursjs-codegen
description: The PureScript compiler's JavaScript backend, rewritten in PureScript.

scripts.sync-tests: git -C ${PURESCRIPT_REPO:-../purescript} archive --format=tar v0.15.15 tests/purs | tar -x -C tests/upstream --strip-components=2 && echo 'purescript@v0.15.15 (synced '$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)')' > tests/upstream/_SOURCE
